decisions.reason: Although it builds on the firm's flooring know-how, this technical sports system sits less clearly in the firm's style-led interior core, and with limited visible market feedback management would likely reallocate resources unless learning and sales have become strong quickly.

A mobile arena floor is technologically related but commercially specialized and operationally demanding, so under an absorptive-capacity logic the firm is likely to drop it if early uptake did not justify further adaptation effort.
This arena-floor variant appears highly niche and overlapping with existing sports-floor development, making it a likely candidate for portfolio pruning despite related knowledge in flooring systems.

Chevron hardwood parquet is very close to the firm's core decorative flooring competences and future direction toward trend-led natural interiors, so the firm is well placed to refine and commercialise it.

The squash-court surface finish uses the firm's surface expertise but serves a narrow specialist market that is less central to its main customer base, raising the chance of discontinuation if scale remained limited.

Oak skirting for sports floors is a simple complementary product that relies strongly on existing wood-processing and accessory knowledge, so it is relatively easy for the firm to support and keep in the range.
